v3b_zones.rule: paired 300 mm bands (layers 1 + 2) + single lines as barriers; slab = outer - beams / columns / barriers, strips narrower than 450 mm effective width excluded

ground_zone_binding.finding: ZONE-1's label lies inside several closed cells and binds to the smallest (outer 103.443 m2) inside footprint FP-1 (227.719 m2); the rest of FP-1 carries no ground-slab zone and no BLOCKED row. Whether that remainder is slab-on-grade is UNRESOLVED (engineer question Q-S4); the defect is the min-area binding rule, not a missing quantity
